review.reason: TensorFlow CPU 2.21.0 is now immutably identified as a viable frozen-GraphDef conversion/runtime candidate and its upstream Python 3.11 lock plus bundled third-party-notice lineage are pinned. Execution remains fail-closed because the exact external Python wheel closure, per-wheel license/notice set, and the current Windows wheel provenance/redistribution lineage have not yet been reconciled into one reproducible package set. The official current TensorFlow installation documentation still describes Windows x86/x64 CPU builds as Intel build-collaborator releases and says tensorflow/tensorflow-cpu installs tensorflow-intel, while the 2.21.0 PyPI release publishes a direct CPython 3.11 tensorflow_cpu Windows wheel and no tensorflow-intel 2.21.0 release endpoint is present. Do not install or execute until that exact package boundary is resolved; do not bypass dependencies or substitute the 2.22.0rc0 prerelease.
